en.title: Word Counter: count words, characters and reading time
en.description: Paste your text to count words, characters and reading time instantly. Runs in your browser, so nothing you type is uploaded or stored.
en.lede: Paste or type your text to see the word count, character count and estimated reading time. It updates as you type and never leaves your browser.

steps.title: Paste or type your text
steps.body: Click the box and paste from any document, email or web page, or start typing. The counts update on every keystroke.

steps.title: Read the numbers
steps.body: Words, characters with and without spaces, and reading time appear below the box. Chinese and Japanese text is counted per word segment, not per space.

steps.title: Edit until you hit your limit
steps.body: Trim or extend the text and watch the numbers change. Use the character counts for limits such as meta descriptions, posts and form fields.

faq: How does the word counter decide what a word is?

It uses the browser's built-in word segmentation for your language. In English that means runs of letters and numbers separated by spaces or punctuation, so a hyphenated term like well-known counts as two words.

Alphabetic text is timed at 238 words per minute, the average silent reading speed for adults. Chinese text is timed at 400 characters per minute. Treat the result as an estimate, since technical or dense writing reads slower.
Is my text uploaded or saved anywhere?
No. The counting happens in your browser tab. Nothing you type is sent to a server, and clearing the box or closing the tab removes it.
Does the counter include spaces and punctuation?
Characters are shown twice: with spaces and without. Punctuation counts as characters in both numbers, while punctuation marks on their own are not counted as words.

examples.input: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
examples.output: 9 words, 44 characters, 36 characters without spaces, reading time under 1 minute
examples.caption: A pangram: nine words, with the final period counted as a character.
A hyphenated term counts as two words.

sections.h2: Check character limits before you publish
sections.body: Search engines cut page titles near 60 characters and meta descriptions near 160. Many social networks stop a post at a fixed length, and forms often cap a field. Paste your draft, read the character count, and trim until it fits. The count with spaces matches most limits, and the count without spaces is useful for services that price by letters.

Essays and assignments usually set a minimum or a maximum in words. A blog post that answers one question often runs 600 to 1,200 words, while a product description stays under 150. The counter segments words the way modern browsers do, so the number should land close to the one in your word processor.

en.limits: The count updates on every keystroke, so a very long text such as a whole book can make typing feel slower. It reads plain text only: formatting, images and text inside scanned PDFs are not counted. Other tools can report slightly different numbers because each one has its own rules for what a word is. Nothing you enter is uploaded, stored or logged.

zh.title: 字数统计：统计字数、字符数和阅读时间
zh.description: 粘贴文本即可即时统计字数、字符数和预计阅读时间。全部在浏览器里完成，你输入的内容不会上传，也不会保存。
zh.lede: 粘贴或输入文本，立即看到字数、字符数和预计阅读时间。统计在输入时实时更新，内容不会离开你的浏览器。

steps.title: 粘贴或输入文本
steps.body: 点击文本框，从文档、邮件或网页粘贴内容，或者直接输入。每次按键后数字都会更新。

steps.title: 查看统计结果
steps.body: 文本框下方显示词数、含空格和不含空格的字符数，以及阅读时间。中日文按词语切分计数，不依赖空格。

steps.title: 改到符合要求为止
steps.body: 删减或补充文本，数字随之变化。可以用字符数核对摘要、帖子和表单字段的长度限制。

faq: 字数统计怎么判断一个词？
使用浏览器内置的分词功能，按你当前的语言处理。英文按空格和标点分隔的字母数字串计数，所以 well-known 这类连字符词算两个词。
字母文字按每分钟 238 个词计算，这是成年人默读的平均速度；中文按每分钟 400 个字计算。结果只是估计，技术类或信息密集的文章读起来会更慢。
我输入的文本会被上传或保存吗？
不会。统计在你的浏览器标签页里完成，输入的内容不会发送到服务器。清空文本框或关闭标签页后内容即消失。
统计会包含空格和标点吗？
字符数会显示两次：含空格和不含空格。标点在两个数字里都算字符，单独的标点符号不会被算作词。

examples.input: 今天天气很好，我们去公园散步。
examples.output: 15 个字符，不含空格也是 15 个字符，阅读时间不到 1 分钟
examples.caption: 中文标点和汉字一样，每个都算一个字符。

examples.output: 2 个词，17 个字符，不含空格 15 个字符
examples.caption: 带连字符的词算作两个词。

sections.h2: 发布前先核对字符限制
sections.body: 搜索引擎会在 60 个字符左右截断页面标题，在 160 个字符左右截断摘要。许多社交平台限制单条帖子的长度，表单字段也常有上限。把草稿粘贴进来，看字符数，删到符合要求为止。含空格的字符数对应大多数限制，不含空格的字符数适合按字数计费的服务。
论文和作业通常规定最少或最多多少字。回答一个问题的博客文章常见在 600 到 1200 词之间，商品描述一般不超过 150 词。统计使用现代浏览器的分词方式，得到的数字应当和你的文字处理软件相近。

zh.limits: 统计在每次输入后更新，所以篇幅很长的文本，例如整本书，可能让输入变慢。它只读取纯文本：格式、图片和扫描版 PDF 里的文字不会被统计。其他工具对“词”的定义各不相同，给出的数字可能略有差异。你输入的内容不会被上传、保存或记录。
